title: 第二十一章第二十二章第二十三章
slug: 纳玄尘第五十三章安凌

第二天出门的时候，天还没全亮透。
苏尘走到马场的时候，阿离已经在门口等着了。她今天换了一身干净些的衣裳——袖口和膝盖上的补丁还在，但洗得很干净，头发也重新扎过。看见苏尘过来，她把背上的布包往上提了提，没说话，跟上了他的步子。
路上的人比昨天少一些。时辰还早，东街的铺子大多没开门，只有一家包子铺已经在冒热气了。老板娘蹲在门口择菜，看见两个小孩走过去，抬头看了一眼，又低下头去。
苏尘没有停下来买包子。
昨天买了葱油饼，今天再买就显得刻意。他在马场吃了早饭——刘叔煮的粥，配了一碟咸菜，简单管饱。阿离也吃了两碗。
两个人就这么一前一后地走着，穿过清晨的街巷，往蒙训院的方向去。
天光渐渐亮起来。
阿离忽然说了一句：“今天的题，我自己做出来了三道。”
苏尘回头看了她一眼。
“哪三道？”
“第七，第九，还有第十一。”
苏尘想了想，那三道题正好是昨天卡住她的——进位之后往下延伸的题型。他没有夸她，只是“嗯”了一声。
阿离也不在意，继续说：“就是第十二题又卡了。”
“午时讲。”
“嗯。”
说完这两个字，两个人又沉默了。但那种沉默不尴尬，像是一条路上两个人各走各的，方向一致，脚步合拍。
到蒙训院的时候，院里已经有人在跑了。
今天的武师换了一个人——不是昨天那个嗓门大的，换了一个更年轻的。二十出头的样子，瘦高个，扎着黑色绑腿，站在操场中间，手里没拿鞭子，拿了一根青竹条。
“新来的，昨天跑过十个圈，今天再加两个。老生照旧。”

一句话就把规矩定完了。
苏尘混在人群里开始跑。今天的十二个圈比昨天的十个圈要命——到第八圈的时候，已经有人开始扶着膝盖喘气了。那个胖子昨天第八圈倒的，今天第六圈就倒了。
苏尘还是保持在中游的位置。不快不慢，不掉队，也不出头。
但他注意到一件事——那个瘦子，昨天跑到第三就没影的那个，今天居然没来。看来只坚持了一天。
跑到最后一圈的时候，青萝从操场边上经过。她今天穿了一身利落的短打，头发扎成高马尾，手里端着一个粗瓷碗，边喝边往教室那边走。经过操场的时候，她朝人群里扫了一眼，看见了阿离，笑了一下，没喊，直接过去了。
阿离看见了那个笑，没回应，但脚下的步子快了一点。
跑完十二圈，年轻武师让所有人原地坐下调息。他说了一句话，让苏尘稍微在意了一下。
“调整呼吸，让心跳慢下来。这不是让你们歇着——这叫炼体的一部分，学会控制自己的身体，跟学会出拳一样重要。”
苏尘坐在人群中间，闭着眼睛，慢慢调整呼吸。他的心跳早就平稳了——就这种强度的训练，对他来说连热身的水平都算不上。但他没有表现出来，他的呼吸节奏和旁边的同学保持同步，甚至还微微喘着，像一个正常跑完十二圈的十五岁少年应该有的样子。
上午的武课还在继续——扎马步，基础拳法。年轻武师教了一套六式的短打拳，说是军中简化过的，叫“开山拳”。招式很简单，一共六招，全是直来直去的路子——冲拳、劈掌、扫腿、顶肘、靠肩、收势。
“这一套拳你们要连练一个月，每天打五十遍。打熟了再教下一套。”
苏尘跟着打了一遍，动作标准得连他自己都觉得意外。前世曹钦练过无数套拳法，这套开山拳对他来说跟喝水一样简单。但他收着打，出拳的力道控制在七分，速度和旁边那个瘦高个差不多，既不出挑也不拖后腿。
练了大概半个时辰之后，武师让大家停下来休息。
然后他转身走进旁边的库房，搬出了一个木箱子。
箱子不大，漆面斑驳，盖子一打开，里面整整齐齐码着三摞册子。薄薄的册子，封面各不一样——一本蓝色封皮，一本灰褐色，一本浅黄色。每一摞大概有二十多本。
操场上的嘈杂声一下子压低了。
“都安静。”年轻武师敲了敲箱盖，“都知道今天要干什么吧？选功法。”
所有人都安静下来了。
“你们大多数人，今天是这辈子第一次接触功法。我说三件事，你们记好。”
他竖起三根手指。

“第一，这里是三本下品玄修基础功法，你们一人选一本，不要钱。选完自己保管好，丢了不补。”
下面有人小声嘀咕：“只有三本啊？”
“你们还想要几本？中品功法？有的话我也想要。”武师一句话怼回去，下面安静了。
“第二，三本功法分别是纳气法、养气诀、引气术。你们可以互相打听、交换意见，但不能抢，不能打架。选好了到我这里登记，领走。”

When we went out the next day, it was not completely bright yet.
When Su Chen walked to the racecourse, A Li was already waiting at the door. She changed into cleaner clothes today - the patches on her cuffs and knees were still there, but they were washed clean and her hair was tied up again. Seeing Su Chen coming, she lifted the cloth bag on her back and followed his pace without saying a word.
There were fewer people on the road than yesterday. It was still early, and most of the shops on East Street were closed. Only one steamed bun shop was already steaming. The proprietress was squatting at the door to choose vegetables. When she saw two children walking past, she looked up and then lowered her head.
Su Chen didn't stop to buy buns.
I bought scallion pancakes yesterday, but buying them again today seems deliberate. He had breakfast at the racecourse - porridge cooked by Uncle Liu with a plate of pickles, which was a simple meal. A Li also ate two bowls.
The two of them walked one behind the other, through the early morning streets and alleys, heading towards the Meng Training Institute.
The sky gradually became brighter.
A Li suddenly said: "I did three of today's questions myself."
Su Chen looked back at her.
"Which three paths?"
"Seventh, ninth, and eleventh."
Su Chen thought for a while, and realized that those three questions were exactly the ones that stuck her yesterday - question types extending downwards after the carry. He didn't praise her, just said "hmm".
Ah Li didn't care and continued: "It's the twelfth question that got stuck again."
"Talk at noon."
"Yeah."
After saying these two words, the two people fell silent again. But that kind of silence is not awkward, like two people walking on the same road, going in the same direction and walking in time.
When we arrived at the Monastery, there were already people running around.
There is a new martial artist today - not the loud one from yesterday, but a younger one. He was in his early twenties, tall and thin, wearing black leggings, standing in the middle of the playground, holding a green bamboo stick instead of a whip.
"The new guy, he ran ten laps yesterday, and he will add two more laps today. It's the same as usual for the old guys."
The rules are set in one sentence.
Su Chen blended into the crowd and started running. Today's twelve laps were worse than yesterday's ten laps - by the eighth lap, some people were already holding their knees and gasping for air. The fat man fell down on the eighth lap yesterday, and he fell down on the sixth lap today.
Su Chen still maintained his position in the middle. Neither fast nor slow, neither falling behind nor getting ahead.
But he noticed one thing - the thin man, the one who ran to third place yesterday and disappeared, actually didn't come today. It seems that it only lasted one day.
When running the last lap, Qingluo passed by the playground. She wore a neat short top today, her hair was tied into a high ponytail, and she was holding a thick porcelain bowl in her hand, drinking as she walked towards the classroom. When passing by the playground, she glanced at the crowd, saw A Li, smiled, and passed directly without shouting.
A Li saw the smile and didn't respond, but his steps were a little faster.
After twelve laps, the young martial artist asked everyone to sit down and adjust their breathing. He said something that made Su Chen pay a little attention.
"Adjust your breathing and slow down your heartbeat. This is not for you to rest - this is part of physical training. Learning to control your body is as important as learning to punch."
Su Chen sat in the middle of the crowd, closed his eyes, and slowly adjusted his breathing. His heartbeat had long since stabilized - training at this intensity was not even a warm-up for him. But he didn't show it. His breathing rhythm was in sync with the classmates next to him, and he was even panting slightly, like a fifteen-year-old boy who had run twelve laps normally.
The morning martial arts class is still going on - Zha Ma Bu, basic boxing skills. The young martial artist taught him a set of six-style short punches, which he said were simplified by the military and were called "Kaishan Fist". The moves are very simple, there are six moves in total, all in a straight line - punch, chop, leg sweep, elbow thrust, shoulder thrust, and closing stance.
"ThisYou have to practice the boxing set for a month, hitting it fifty times every day. Once you are familiar with it, you can teach the next one. "
Su Chen followed suit, and the movements were so standard that even he felt surprised. In his previous life, Cao Qin had practiced countless sets of boxing techniques, and this Kaishan Boxing set was as easy for him as drinking water. But he held back his punches, controlling the force of his punches to only seven points, and his speed was about the same as that of the tall and lanky man next to him, neither challenging nor holding back.
After practicing for about half an hour, the martial arts master asked everyone to stop and rest.
Then he turned around and walked into the nearby warehouse and moved out a wooden box.
The box was not big, and the paint was mottled. Once the lid was opened, there were three stacks of books neatly stacked inside. The thin books have different covers - one is blue, one is taupe, and one is light yellow. There are about twenty books in each pile.
The noise on the playground suddenly dropped.
“All quiet. The young martial artist knocked on the lid of the box and said, "You all know what you are going to do today, right?" Choose exercises. "
Everyone fell silent.
“For most of you, today is the first time in your life that you have come into contact with the exercises. I will tell you three things. Remember them. "
He held up three fingers.
"First, here are three basic exercises for low-grade Xuanxiu. Each of you can choose one for free. After selecting, keep it by yourself and don’t replace it if you throw it away. "
Someone below whispered: "There are only three books? "
"How many more do you want? A middle-grade skill? If there are any, I want them too. "The martial artist replied with one sentence, and the crowd became quiet.
“Second, the three basic skills are the method of absorbing qi, the method of nourishing qi, and the method of entraining qi. You can inquire about each other and exchange opinions, but you cannot rob or fight. Once you have chosen, come to me to register and take it away. "
